title: Tamil Nadu mein male government employees ke liye 15 din ki paternity leave ka ailan
summary: Tamil Nadu sarkar ne male government employees ke liye 15 din ki paternity leave ka ailan kiya hai, jise delivery se pehle ya bachhe ke janm ke 6 mahine ke andar liya ja sakega.
key_points: Male government employees ko milegi 15 din ki paternity leave
Leave ko delivery se 15 din pehle ya 6 mahine ke andar liya ja sakta hai
Tamil Nadu ki female employees ko pehle se 365 din ki maternity leave milti hai
Yeh faisla employees ki maang aur shared parenting ko badhava dene ke liye liya gaya hai
body: Tamil Nadu sarkar ne male government employees ke liye 15 din ki paternity leave shuru karne ka ailan kiya hai. Is naye niyam ke tahat, married male employees ko bachhe ke janm ke aas-paas kaafi madad mil sakegi aur woh parivar ke sath waqt bita payenge.

Official release ke mutabiq, yeh leave delivery ki expected date se 15 din pehle ya fir bachhe ke janm ke baad 6 mahine ke andar kabhi bhi li ja sakti hai. Sarkar ka kehna hai ki yeh kadam shared parenting aur bachhe ki dekhbhal mein fathers ki active participation ko badhava dene ke liye uthaya gaya hai.

Ye faisla employees ki taraf se mil rahi requests ke baad liya gaya hai, jismein male employees ke liye bhi leave ki maang ki gayi thi. Sarkar ne maana ki bachhe ke janm ke baad ka waqt mother aur newborn dono ke liye kafi zaroori hota hai.

Bata dein ki Tamil Nadu mein female government employees ke liye pehle se hi 365 din ki paid maternity leave ka pravdhan hai. Haal hi mein sarkar ne teesre bachhe ke liye bhi is maternity leave ko extend kiya tha.
why_it_matters: Is naye ailan se working families ko newborn ki dekhbhal aur early parenthood ke dauran aapas mein zimmedariyan baantne mein asani hogi. Sarkari karmachariyon ke liye is tarah ki leave se work-life balance behtar banane mein madad milti hai.
